notes:
Clearer Shift Entry, a new Trade Credit page and safer numbers

- Shift Entry warns in red when the date is not today, with a "Go to today" button.
- "Submit shift" stays grey until at least one machine is saved, and tells you which machines are not entered.
- Empty screens say "Nothing entered yet" instead of a green "Balanced".
- A machine shows "Draft on this phone" as soon as you come back from it.
- Payments: one row of + Cash, + Online, + Card, + Udhar, + Expense buttons. Only what you added is shown, so nothing hides.
- New credit customer from Shift Entry: name, plus mobile, address and note (all optional).
- Trade Credit: slimmer total, sort by biggest or longest waiting, "last entry" days on each customer.
- Customer page: pending, unpaid since how many days, WhatsApp reminder, Call, and a pencil to edit the customer.
- Money looks the same everywhere (−₹500, never ₹-0). Expenses and credit given have no confusing minus.
- Pocket: smaller cards and a short note when a balance is below zero.
- History: an empty day just says "No shift entered".
- More: shows who is logged in. Clock and battery icons are readable on every screen.
